title: Nepeta Cataria Uses, Benefits, And Remedies
intro: Nepeta cataria, commonly known as catnip, is a perennial herb belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae) native to Europe, Asia, and North Africa. It is renowned for its calming effects on cats and humans alike, offering a range of health benefits such as reducing anxiety, aiding digestion, and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of this herb are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including nepetalactone, rosmarinic acid, and essential oils. Herbal preparations such as infusions, tinctures, and salves can be made from nepeta cataria to harness its soothing and medicinal properties.
